   3.      Audit Plan for the Regulatory Audit of “SMR-300 Concrete Strengthened
           Steel Structures Design and Analysis Methodology Licensing Topical Report,”
           (ML26033A013)
By letter dated December 2, 2025 (ML25336A060), SMR, LLC, a Holtec International
Company (Holtec), submitted the licensing topical report (LTR), “Concrete Strengthened
Steel Structures Design and Analysis Methodology Licensing Topical Report,” HI-2251825
Revision 0 (Reference 1) to the U.S Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC). The NRC
accepted the LTR for review (Reference 2) and issued the audit plan (Reference 3).
The purpose of this letter is to provide responses to NRC audit questions, associated
changes to the LTR supporting those responses, and three structural element test reports
supporting the NRC staff review
Enclosure 1 contains the NRC audit question, Holtec responses, and associated markups
to LTR Revision 0 (Public Version). Enclosure 2 contains the corresponding non-public
version of Enclosure 1.
Enclosures 3, 4, and 5 contain the structural element test reports. These enclosures are
provided only in non-public form because they contain no public information. Enclosures
2, 3, 4, and 5 contain proprietary information, and Holtec requests that such information
be withheld from public disclosure in accordance with the affidavit provided in Enclosure
6.
